And I'm right back where I started...

I had been doing so well for months and everything has come back full circle, if not worse. This move was supposed to be great for the both of us. More money and better opportunity for him. Getting away from all the bad stuff in our old town and new opportunities for me. But, everything is not how we would hoped it would be. Money is even tighter than before. Like cleaning, finding a better job or a second job. I lay awake stressing about how to help more when I feel like everything I do now isn't enough, and I'm just waiting for everything to come crashing down. 

Yet, on the other hand, I am ANGRY. I'm angry that I'm getting no help from him. I do all the household chores amidst his claims every day of "after work I'll come home and clean". It's my paycheck and any extra cash I get a hold of that is immediately spent on bills because his check wasn't enough because sales were down the last month, or was spent on game passes and subscriptions for games. I was the one who drove there and back to go do his errands while he was sitting on the beach in Mexico with his friends. 

And I. Feel. Terrible. 

I'm right back to being sucked into this numbness, this darkness. All I want again is to just not wake up in the morning. To have everything just be over. The thoughts of suicide and self harm are back in full force and the only reason I haven't harmed, is because I simply don't have a razor blade in the house... 

I'm sorry this post is a mess, and I don't have anywhere else to get this off my chest. So, thank you if you stuck through it. I'm sorry.

I don't have the energy to explain all the trauma and horrible things to happen that have brought me to this point and I don't want to hear "it gets better" or any shit about time. I've struggled with this for 4 years and it only gets worse. I've done countless types of therapy, medication, exercise, yoga, meditation, journaling, socializing...I've tried it endlessly and nothing helps. I've lost every single thing I've cared about. I've tried to find something to hold on to. Something to fight for. A reason to live. I've tried but nothing matters to me. I've stopped caring about all my hobbies and passions and dreams. I've begged loved ones and counselors to help me, to give me a reason to live, and nobody will. Does anybody that can actually relate have any advice or a reason that might actually matter to me?
